discrepancies.source_ref: Supplement Eq. (S2) and Supplement Fig. S1
discrepancies.observation: Every plotted S1 level is approximately 0.5 hbar*omega below the absolute energy printed by Eq. (S2), while slopes, degeneracies, and gaps agree.
discrepancies.independent_check: Direct integer enumeration of E_nm/(hbar*omega)=n+1-m*Omega/omega for all displayed n,m branches.
discrepancies.reason: An unannounced common energy-zero convention would explain the shift without changing the physics; fresh independent review is absent.

discrepancies.source_ref: Supplement Fig. S3(c) caption and surrounding Ramsey text
discrepancies.observation: The caption prints a Laughlin anisotropy of 21.4(1) Hz, whereas the body text reports the observed oscillation frequency as 19.6(1) Hz.
discrepancies.independent_check: Both values were transcribed independently from the frozen PDF; T012 uses 19.6 Hz and records that choice explicitly.
discrepancies.reason: The quantities may refer to different fitted/calibrated observables; the article does not provide enough raw data to distinguish them.

reproduction_defects_repaired.description: The initial Ramsey implementation used the wrong zero-delay phase; the two-pulse protocol requires a return to occupation 2 at t=0.
